response.name: Oh My Ghost Collection
response.original_name: มหากาพย์หอแต๋วแตก

parts.title: Haunting Me
parts.overview: Four aging drag queens who run a boarding house for boys try all sorts of crazy schemes to get rid of the ghosts haunting their dormitory.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกกระเจิง
parts.overview: A group of friends encounters a folk spirit in their apartment, and their harebrained attempts to banish the ghost soon backfire.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost 2
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหวกชิมิ
parts.overview: The spirited trio are back to take on a new ghost-busting adventure at a mens residence, where spooky secrets lurk around every corner.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost 3
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกมว๊ากมว๊ากกก
parts.overview: After a body is discovered in their building, a vengeful, paranormal presence begins to affect Taew, Mod Dum and Cartoon's business.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost 4
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกนะคะ
parts.overview: Ghosts wreak havoc at the old school, and a student communicates with the spirit while the team reckons with a power struggle.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost 6
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกต่อไม่รอแล้วนะ
parts.overview: Taew and friends are invited to a mansion which the mansion owner is choosing the new landlord. To win the mansion award, they have to dress up in Indian clothes and pretend to be Indian.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost! The Fierce Escape from Covid-19
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกโควิดปังปุริเย่
parts.overview: When the hotel run by Taew is found to have a COVID-19 case, it is shut down and everyone there must remain in quarantine for 14 days. The messy and spooky happenings wages on, even the zombies rise to chase people.

parts.title: Pojaman The Legacy
parts.original_title: พจมาน สว่างคาตา
parts.overview: Pojamarn, a fair lady, moves from her village to study in Bangkok to satisfy her father's antemortem wish. She lives with her aunt, Mom Ampara, in a big mansion called Dokmaithong.

parts.title: Oh My Ghost : The Finale
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกสัปะหยด
parts.overview: Strange things begin happening to Kouy, the beloved son of Taew, prompting her to seek help from Panda, the calm twin of the mischievous ghost Pancake.

parts.title: Hor Taew Tak: Split Li Hu
parts.original_title: หอแต๋วแตก แหกหลีหู
parts.overview: When the Empress died with a mystery, causing the nobles to shut up and find a way to solve the situation and find clues about who is behind this incident.
